import pathlib
import re
import sys

files = [pathlib.Path(x) for x in sys.argv[1:]]

text = "\n".join(
    p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    for p in files
    if p.exists()
)

checks = {
    "CI_UNKNOWN_OBSERVED":
        r"\bCI UNKNOWN\b",

    "CONTROLLER_SIGTERM_OBSERVED":
        r"controller signal=15",

    "EXACT_SHA_OBSERVED":
        r"0c11a13e0c6ceb4c9eab3258ce4a10728fcb6390",

    "EXACT_WORKFLOW_OBSERVED":
        r"0f6fcfa4-4fb0-419d-ba4d-ca77af5d0c62",

    "EXACT_PIPELINE_OBSERVED":
        r"4df05bd2-6a81-41dc-9dfe-9e0051cd602c",

    "TIMEOUT_OBSERVED":
        r"TimeoutExpired|timed out",

    "ANCHOR_NOT_FOUND_OBSERVED":
        r"SEMAPHORE_EXACT_ANCHORS_NOT_FOUND",

    "OOM_OR_KERNEL_KILL_EVIDENCE":
        r"oom-kill|out of memory|Killed process",

    "SYSTEMD_STOP_EVIDENCE":
        r"Stopping .*ai-loop|Stopped .*ai-loop|Main process exited",
}

for key, pattern in checks.items():
    found = bool(re.search(pattern, text, re.I))
    print(f"{key}={'YES' if found else 'NO'}")

print("SEMAPHORE_QUERY_PERFORMED=NO")
print("VPS_QUERY_PERFORMED=NO")
print("REMOTE_MUTATION=NO")
print("LOCAL_MUTATION=EVIDENCE_DIR_ONLY")
print("CI_RERUN=NO")
print("PROCESS_SIGNAL_SENT=NO")
print("SERVICE_ACTION=NO")
